name: SmartRent
positioning: Smart apartment hardware and software sold to the operator, not to the resident.
description: SmartRent provides smart home hardware and a management platform for rental housing: smart locks, thermostats, leak sensors, self-guided tour access, community access control and parking, managed centrally by the operator across a portfolio.
real_estate_use: Three operational cases drive the purchase. Self-guided tours let a prospect visit a vacant unit without staff. Smart locks remove the key handover and the lock change at turnover. Leak sensors catch water damage — the largest avoidable insurance claim in multifamily — before it reaches the unit below.
features: Smart locks with credential management at turnover
Self-guided tour access for prospective residents
Leak detection and water shut-off alerting
Community access control and parking management

use_cases.job: Offer self-guided tours of vacant units without on-site staff
Reduce water damage claims and turnover costs across a portfolio
